summary.text: Tonya Phillips, listed by Ballotpedia as Tonya Myers Phillips, is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 7 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and public policy advisor, she is director of community partnerships and development at the Sugar Law Center for Social and Economic Justice.

paragraphs.text: Myers Phillips was born in Detroit and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan in 1999 and a J.D. from the University of Michigan Law School in 2003.
Ballotpedia says she also serves as a public policy advisor for Michigan Legal Services.
She took office in 2025 and serves on the Energy Committee and the Natural Resources and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Reginald Moorer in the general election on November 3, 2026.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Myers Phillips described herself as an attorney who grew up in Detroit and said she had served on the City of Detroit Charter Commission.
She listed the social safety net, access to justice, equitable economic development and racial justice as her policy priorities.
